name: Abyssal Commander's Bow (0 AC)
description: Abyssal Angel Commanders sail the Celestial Seas, and are feared across the realms for the cutthroat ways they have of taking their opponents down.

name: Abyssal Commander's Bow (AC)
description: Abyssal Angel Commanders sail the Celestial Seas, and are feared across the realms for the cutthroat ways they have of taking their opponents down.

name: Airship Assault-bow
description: Calling all SkyGuard! Due to the SkyPirate threat, we remain on High Alert. Prepare your Weapons and ready yourselves for battle!

name: Alabaster Lily Bow
description: This bow doesn't need arrows. If one's diligence and dedication to purity are untainted, pull the bowstring back and release. The horizon will be cleansed of impurities.

name: Algie's Bow
description: Proof of your victory over Bowmaster Algie. Re's smile widened as she learned of the traitor's demise. "22 years late" she said.

name: Animancer Bow
description: A bow that aims for the reapers. Death will not have it's day.

name: Anseri Destroyer Bow
description: Slay your enemies from the back of your Anseri charger, then race to the next opponent before they even know they've fallen!

name: Arachno Bow
description: This bow has been masterfully crafted from the remains of a powerful Souleater. It is much more practical in this fashion.

name: Arcane Bow of Light (0 AC)
description: The Order of the LightCasters was formed to support the Champion of Light. Only those who dedicate themselves to the study of the deepest myeteries become Arcane LightCasters.

name: Arcane Bow of Light (AC)
description: The Order of the LightCasters was formed to support the Champion of Light. Only those who dedicate themselves to the study of the deepest myeteries become Arcane LightCasters.

name: Arcane Bow of Light (Legend)
description: The Order of the LightCasters was formed to support the Champion of Light. Only those who dedicate themselves to the study of the deepest myeteries become Arcane LightCasters.

name: Arcane Longbow
description: A bow crafted to work with a special school of magic enhanced archery.

name: Arco do Amor e Alegria
description: Some people need some motivation to chase after love and happiness. Dancers feel a surge of confidence once they're given the means to hunt for it.

name: Arco do Amor e Folia
description: Some people need some motivation to chase after love and happiness. Dancers feel a surge of confidence once they're given the means to hunt for it.

name: Arctic Breeze Bow
description: Feel the rush of a snow-laden breeze as you pluck the string of this bow. The refreshing touch will couple the exhilarating feeling of taking down yet another foe.

name: Arjuna's Bow
description: Through your courage, strength, and humility, truth and justice will spread throughout the land.

name: Arrows of Truth
description: Strike swiftly and strike quickly for truth, justice, and honor!

name: Asphodel Hunter's Bow
description: A bow blessed by Nature. Its magic has only grown stronger in the hands of the Legion. The tears of the Asphodel mourners strengthen its magic, and guides your aim.

name: Aurora Caller's Bow
description: A sect of Luminomancers, Aurora Callers summon the northern lights and draw power from the bright magic contained inside them.

name: Avatar's Flame Bow
description: The Elemental Avatars act through their Champions on Lore. The power, passion, and energy they bestow burning with an intensity that would sear a normal mortal's mind and body.

name: Awakened Bow of Zelkur
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Awakened Fiend Bow (0 AC)
description: The weapon seethes, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Awakened Fiend Bow (AC)
description: The weapon seethes, pulsing power ciphoned from the trapped Fiend God themselves. Some whisper that the Archfiend will one day take on its fearsome form when he ascends.

name: Basilisk Ranger's Longbow
description: The Basilisk is easily the most deadly of the four legendary beasts of Greenguard Forest. Its stare is as deadly as its venomous bite. No hunter would dare track this beast… until you proved it could be defeated.

name: Bass Clef Bow
description: Your opponents are in a world of treble when being pummeled by this color custom bow. Bring the battle to the bands (of monsters)!

name: Bayou Bow
description: Brandish your bow created from organic matter found within the bayou!

name: Bejeweled Bounty Bow
description: The luxurious bow is struggling under the weight of a pirate's entire bounty. If your target manages to survive getting shot by your golden arrows, they'll be able to retire comfortably.

name: Black Iron Bow
description: Nightmares strike fear into all those who remember. And the Black Iron Bow does just that--but it inflicts a permanent reminder!

name: Black Skull Bow
description: Strike a bulls-eye on the target to knock out its soul for the dark spirit twins that inhabit the dual skulls to devour.

name: Blacksteel Dragon Bow
description: The obsidian metal used for this bow is coated in a super-heated dragonbane coating, specially prepare to /slay ANY of Lore's dread dragons.

name: Blinding Bow of Destiny
description: You're path of virtue is now complete! Only the virtuous ones are able to wield this bow.

name: Blood Ranger Bow
description: My arrows always find their mark. Let their message drain you of your soul! (Item does 50% more damage to dragon tagged monsters when equipped.)

name: Bow Knows Candy
description: I know how to shoot a bow! also defeating creatures! also getting all of the candy!

name: Bow of Bravery
description: The boldest of bows!

name: Bow of Concealment
description: Only after you realize that they are handling a bow, do you hear the whistle of the arrow as it hurdles straight towards you.

name: Bow of Destiny
description: Only those who follow the path of virtue will be able to wield this magical bow.

name: Bow of Divine Heart
description: During the festivals of Lupercalia that predated Heroes Heart Day, contestants in love tourneys would compete to hunt doves. The winner would present the feathers to their soulmate.

name: Bow of Embers (0 AC)
description: This bow as discovered by a Pyroclastic Necromancer as they journeyed deep into the heart of a volcano, hunting for new minions.

name: Bow of Embers (AC)
description: This bow as discovered by a Pyroclastic Necromancer as they journeyed deep into the heart of a volcano, hunting for new minions.

name: Bow of Judgement
description: Even the Legion needs Ranged weapons… and this is the strongest of them all.

name: Bow of Omniramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Bow of Semiramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Bow of the Archfiend
description: Crafted by fiendish weaponsmiths chained to infernal forges, this bow was crafted in honor of Nulgath the ArchFiend. Only the strongest members of his Nation are worthy of wielding it.

name: Bow of the Oracle
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Protect yourself. Most will viciously rebuke the truth.

name: Bow of the Truth
description: For a hunter seeking veracity, fire an arrow at the liars and they will sing the truth.

name: Bow of Viltusial
description: Cupid doesn't have anything on this celestial bow.

name: Bow of Zelkur
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Bow-quet of Roses
description: This beauty is more than just thorns. Let arrows rain and petals fall.

name: Bow to the Shadows
description: Only those who follow the path of the dishonor will be able to wield this misfortunate bow.

name: Bright Bow of Destiny
description: You are on the path of the virtue with this bow in hand.

name: Bright Bow of Light
description: The Order of the LightCasters was formed to support the Champion of Light. Only those who dedicate themselves to the study of the deepest mysteries become Arcane LightCasters.

name: Bright Bow of the Dawn
description: A bow blessed by the magic of the original Dawn Vindicator, Gramiel. This is the highest honor a Vindicator can receive. Their own leader will guide the arch of their arrows.

name: Bright Grove Bow
description: Native to the Grove, some fairies only appear when Lucky Day is near.

name: Bright Mana Flame Bow
description: The Elemental Avatars act through their Champions on Lore, prevented from connecting to the Mana Core that is the heart of our world. Should the flame of its power be extinguished, the spirit of our world itself would die out.

name: Bright Shadowfall Bow
description: *No description*

name: Bright SnowAngel's Bow (AC)
description: No matter how dark the night, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: Bright SnowAngel's Bow (Legend)
description: No matter how dark the night, the purity of a snow angel's spirit shines brighter than the North Star.

name: BrightFrost Elf Bow
description: Elves are some of the most resourceful beings in Lore. Even the colds of the Northlands cannot keep these skilled warriors away.

name: Candycorn Bow
description: This sweet treat might look corny, but you can make your enemies eat dirt if you wield it well.

name: Celebration Bow
description: A wooden toy given to aspiring new heroes during one of the most special days in Battleon. The forests will have new Rangers protecting the peace.

name: Celestial Guardian Bow
description: Guard the Celestial Realm well, Hero, and Aranx will be in your debt.

name: Celestial Pyromancer's Bow
description: The blood and magical power of Celestial Pyromancers burn in their veins, a force that very few mortals can oppose.

name: Celestial Sharpshooter Bow
description: The bright power emanating from this bow soothes your spirit and renews your flagging energy. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Celtic Hunter Bow
description: This epic Celtic Hunter Bow is from a dimension far, far away… one where your luck, skill, and strength in battle will lead you to VICTORY!

name: Ceremonial Dragon Bow (0 AC)
description: A bow of grand importance, forged in honor of a great Dragonlord who fought through chaos and shadows, prevailing over all.

name: Ceremonial Dragon Bow (AC)
description: A bow of grand importance, forged in honor of a great Dragonlord who fought through chaos and shadows, prevailing over all.

name: Chaos Hunter Crossbow
description: Skulls and Crossbows! Chaos will never know what hit 'em!

name: Charged Electrowave Bow

name: Charged Shockwave Bow
description: The Electrowave Scholar's arrows aren't meant to be fatal. They paralyze potential test subjects so the scholars can safely bring them back to their labs.

name: Cold Delusions Bow
description: A destructive bow that can shoot the stars. The more the bowstring is pulled, the harder the tendrils clutch your hand. Soon, master and weapon become one.

name: Cold Maw Bow
description: The head of honored prey decorates this weapon. It's teeth will cut into the hands of a wavering hunter… if Ddog doesn't manage to grab it first.

name: Combat Cupid's Bow
description: The affection increases when an arrow of love is accurately fired.

name: Conflict Resolution Bow
description: Like the people it's meant to defend, this bow is shattered. Through your effort, you can reunite warring people and reconstruct this bow! Happy United Nations Day 2012!

name: Conquest Bow
description: The white heat of this bow makes it unwieldable by anyone but the spirit of Conquest… or those the possesses.

name: Corrupt Gandiva (0 AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors.

name: Corrupt Gandiva (AC)
description: Not many dragons exist in the Underworld but a few must be wrangled by the most fierce dragon warriors.

name: Covert Judicator Bow
description: A shadow can only be cast by someone standing in the light. And at times, the Light needs to conduct its business unseen.

name: Crystallis Wayfinder
description: Kotaro made this particular weapon through the fragments of space and time. The arrow which rests on this bow has been known to find its own target at will. It's speed is truly remarkable.

name: Cupid of Evil Bow
description: For those who want a reason to shoot people with arrows and not get in trouble. Spread the love…errr evil!

name: Cupid's Bow
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: Take aim and draw back the arrow of fate. Strike true, strike swift and strike only once. For if you miss, Cupid will make you pay. Suggested by Ganloth.

name: Curved Beastbow of the Underworld
description: That eye will watch every shot you take, so be sure not to miss.

name: Cutesy GrenwogSlayer's Bow
description: Enemies will be asking fur trouble against this bunny bow.

name: Cyclone Aerodu Shortbow
description: Comes with a sheaf of arrows made from bone.

name: Dark Lovely Deity's Bow
description: Launch your arrows to vanquish the evils that threaten love, or to stoke the evils that inspire love and give it passion. No matter what you choose, at least one of the love deities will be pleased.

description: The Elemental Avatars act through their Champions on Lore, prevented from connecting to the Mana Core that is the heart of our world. Should the flame of its power be extinguished, the spirit of our world itself would die out.

name: Decima Soul Bow
description: It conjures its own arrows when a Sentinel tugs on the bowstring. If an arrow does not appear, it means that the battle is over.

description: A massive and sturdy boy of dwarven design. It takes a massive amount of strength to bend the bow but fires with unrivaled power.

name: Dessert Bow
description: The best part of the Harvest Feast is the dessert course!

name: Diabolical Ectobow
description: This bow shoots something a little different than arrows, it seems. Hopefully it's not too hard to aim.

description: A skillfully crafted bow created in the image of a legendary dragon. The string is believed to be a piece of hair from said dragon.

name: Dragonbow
description: It's a bow! With dragons! This would look nicely placed upon a present. Bows, ribbons, giftwrap… the whole shebang.

name: Dramatic Royal's Showstopper
description: *Sings* Who runs the world? GIR -- *cough*

description: This blackened bow shoots arrows of pure chaos.

description: Elegant and dependable, able to scare off Horcs.

name: Embersea Overlord's Bow
description: The volcanoes that ring Embersea burn with an elemental fury. Only the strongest rulers can survive reigning over this land.

name: Emerald Fairy Bow
description: During Lucky Day all of the Fairies come out to celebrate with their friends. The Emerald Fairies enjoy the woods, and can often be found in forests.

name: Enchanted BeastMaster Bow
description: This bow helps protect nature.

name: Enchanted Daimyo's Bow
description: Elaborate armor worn by only the highest level of Akiban defenders. Rank is denoted by the symbols on your chest. (Item is CC)

name: Enchanted Forest Rogue Bow
description: With your bow and arrow, you patrol the forest taking from the rich and defending the poor. The villagers are so thankful you are near.

name: Enchanted Hollowborn Bow
description: The light of the Dawn Vindicator's leader has been swallowed by Hollowborn Shadows. The light struggles, soon to be snuffed out, but the bow remains as deadly as ever.

name: Enchanted Regal Dragon Hunter Yumi
description: A man became a Prince when he helped his brother slay an evil Dragon, bringing the Yokai Isles into an age of prosperity. These bows are regal copies of his original wooden weapon.

name: Enchanted Timeseeker's Chrono Bow
description: Only the most skilled Treasurehunters become Timeseekers, questing across the timestreams that make up the fabric of our universe. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Energized TimeSplitter Bow
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Enraged Pyromancer's Bow
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAH

name: Eros' Bow
description: If you ever wanted to look like a cross between Cupid and a Mad Scientist, here's your chance!

name: Eternal BeastMaster's Bow
description: Using the powers of Shadow and Chaos, these BeastMasters use all their skills in support of Malgor.(Color Customizable)

name: Eternal Duality Bow
description: The fight between Good and Evil is never more apparent than when it takes over your entire being. Which way do you lean?

name: Evolved Soulreaper Bow
description: A soul sucking reward for those that have served well under their master, Nulgath, and must promise to continue doing so for such a ghastly arsenal to reach its true potential.

name: Faerie Guardian's Bow
description: The Faeries of Greenguard Forest are known to keep butterflies as pets, and craft many of their outfits based on the colorful patterns of the Monarch Butterfly's wings.

name: Falcon Ranger Harp Bow
description: Does the hawk sing out of respect for its worthy prey? No, and it's more of a screech than a song, but this is more poetic.

name: Falconer's Bow
description: An elegant bow created especially for the Royal Falconers of Swordhaven.

name: Falling Leaves Bow
description: As the leaves fall to the forest floor, it heralds the change in seasons, when creatures sleep and the earth prepares for the long, dark cold of winter. But right now, the forest is ablaze with color, and the crisp air is tinged with the smoke of burning leaves.

name: Festive Archer Bow (0 AC)
description: The merriest of the merry men (and women) of Greenguard Forest!

name: Festive Archer Bow (AC)
description: The merriest of the merry men (and women) of Greenguard Forest!

name: Festive Archer Bow (Legend)
description: The merriest of the merry men (and women) of Greenguard Forest!

name: Festive Elf's Bow
description: Poor Elf! Who knows how long the outfits have been stuck inside Giefurious!

name: Festive Golden Snowflake Bow
description: A festively decorated bow that helps light the way during night hunts.

name: Festive Holiday Bow
description: A festive and beautiful holiday bow crafted from pure silver and and deep blue sapphire found only in the stones near Frostvale!

name: Fiendish Bloodhunter Bow
description: A bow made of flesh and sinew from the Nation's quarry. It seems to have been made from the remains of a denizen of Darkness.

name: Fissure Bow (AC)
description: A relic from a time before the light; when time was not yet known, and worlds had yet to exist…

name: Fissure Bow (Legend)
description: A relic from a time before the light; when time was not yet known, and worlds had yet to exist…

name: Forest Rogue Bow
description: With your bow and arrow, you patrol the forest taking from the rich and defending the poor. The villagers are so thankful you are near.

name: Frost Guard's Bow
description: Keep warm this holiday season in an extra warm armor - also good for protecting various body parts when dealing with dracoliches.

name: Frostval Villager's Bow
description: In the little town of Snowsheart Peak, the villagers know you have to depend on each other, because the world is cold and dark and scary. But by helping each other, everything -- and everyone -- will be alright.

name: Galaxy Bow
description: When fired from this bow, arrows will travel in a straight line and not abide by the laws of gravity.

name: Geodic Warrior's Bow (0 AC)
description: By the strength of the stones that shape their bones, Geodic Warriors are bound to serve the Avatar of Earth.

name: Geodic Warrior's Bow (AC)
description: By the strength of the stones that shape their bones, Geodic Warriors are bound to serve the Avatar of Earth.

name: Glacial Bow
description: The first of these bows was found in an ancient glacier and replicated by the best and strongest Ice mages of modern times. Use it wisely.

name: Glacial FrostElf Bow
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for the Winter Moon celebration.

name: Golden Bow
description: Love is in the air…

name: Golden FrostElf Bow
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for winter court audiences.

name: Golden Lightweaver Bow
description: The power of Elemental Light surges from the glowing gemstone embedded into the bow. It manifests brilliant arrows with its magic, and grows dimmer with each use. Only Lightweavers are able to replace the gem.

name: Golden Octantis Bow (0 AC)
description: During the darkest of nights, the Light bestowed a star upon a worthy bowman. It was shot into the heavens, summoning the morning sun. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Golden Octantis Bow (AC)
description: During the darkest of nights, the Light bestowed a star upon a worthy bowman. It was shot into the heavens, summoning the morning sun. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Gorillaphant Tusk Bow
description: Horcs use all parts of animal. Better to make life worth living, even in death.

name: GrandMaster Enchanted Bow
description: To become a GrandMaster it takes skill, a cunning eye, a sharp blade and a good fire retardant armor.

name: Greenguard Ranger's Bow
description: Skulking through Greenguard Forest, the Greenguard Rangers are stealthy, wealthy and wise to the ways of their opponents.

name: GrenwogSlayer's Bow
description: Enemies will be asking fur trouble against this bunny bow.

name: Grotesque Bow
description: This bow wriggles and writhes with dark energies.

name: Halcyon Bow of Blessings
description: This bow shoots arrows of icy light. It was crafted from a fallen star, and as you stare at it, you can sense an immence, ancient power.

name: Harvest Hunter Bow
description: Brings the phrase scrounging for food to a whole new level. These hunters explore Greenguard for food.

name: Heartbeat Festa Bow
description: A bow that conjures its own arrows, and fires them as fast as your heart can beat!

name: Heartbeat Glimmer Bow
description: A bow that conjures its own arrows, and fires them as fast as your heart can beat!

name: Herald of the Eclipse Bow (0 AC)
description: Eclipses are a herald of disaster. Or, do are they signs of change? This bow was made from magic that is aligned with both the Light and the Dark. With your arrows, you get to decide the balance of Lore.

name: Herald of the Eclipse Bow (AC)
description: Eclipses are a herald of disaster. Or, do are they signs of change? This bow was made from magic that is aligned with both the Light and the Dark. With your arrows, you get to decide the balance of Lore.

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Bow (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Evoker's Bow (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Ranger Bow
description: A lightweight bow that bears the remnant of its original affiliation. The Vindicators lost another light to the shadows of the Hollowborn.

name: Hollowborn Thunderlord Bow
description: The power of thunder and lightning is a difficult one to wield - one that only the most determined of Hollowborn can master.

name: Honra Selvagem Short Bow
description: Simple but effective.

name: Hydra Bow
description: Quick-draw your quiver! Ready your bow! Aim for the beast's head! Ready… aim… BOOM HEADSHOT!

name: IceBreaker Bow
description: Your enemies will freeze in fear when you step into the battlefield!

name: IceStorm Archer's Bow (0 AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors.  No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: IceStorm Archer's Bow (AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors.  No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: Immortal Yew Bow
description: A long-lived tree gave this bow its wisdom and magic. But the yew could not survive in the sea, and disappeared with its original master when it sought to rescue the Ashray. Their duties and this bow have been passed to you.

name: Infernal Flame Bow
description: The arrows fired by this bow look brittle and scorched, but they flare up in flight. It aims for Celestial kin, and burn them until they fall to the earth as Infernals.

name: Inferno Bow
description: This bow feels comfortably warm in your hands. I think that means it likes you. Do try to keep it that way.

name: Ionized TimeSplitter Bow
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Kestrel
description: A tool of iron imbued with clear discernment. Forged as a deathbed to those who flee.

name: Kogane no Yumi
description: Wielded by the soldiers of Yokai Isle.

name: Lavarock Destroyer's Bow (0 AC)
description: Molten rock twisted and hardened into jagged blades fit for their breath starved masters. Fire still pulses, and just being near them suffocates the living.

name: Lavarock Destroyer's Bow (AC)
description: Molten rock twisted and hardened into jagged blades fit for their breath starved masters. Fire still pulses, and just being near them suffocates the living.

name: Legacy Of Sai
description: (click handle to transform) Technocasters are a group of elite Seraphic warriors from the future. The golden armor that they wear helps guard them against radiation, and any number of space-borne illnesses.

name: Legendary Bow
description: Wileded by legendary Hero xserenax, this bow was crafted in the image of her favorite, most trustworthy weapon!

name: Light Void Reverent Bow
description: What happens to stars when they were swallowed by the void? Anyone struck by an arrow shot by a Void Reverent will find out for themselves. (Item is color-custom to Eye.)

name: Lisianthus Bloom Bow
description: The arrows that fly from this bow will always strike true if it is to protect the beautiful. Though, they can accidentally hit the beautiful if the person aiming is too distracted.

name: Lovely Deity's Bow
description: Launch your arrows to vanquish the evils that threaten love, or to stoke the evils that inspire love and give it passion. No matter what you choose, at least one of the love deities will be pleased.

name: Lucky Clover Bow
description: This bow has the leaves of a four-leaf clover laquered on. A bit o' luck will always stand a ranger in good stead as they battle.

name: Luminous Soul Bow
description: A bow imbued with powerful spells, lit by the color of one's soul. The Light sees all, and will destroy all in your way. In exchange, it only asks for adoration.

name: Lustrous Bow
description: This luminous bow will light the way through the darkness as you hunt your enemies.

name: Luxorlight Bow
description: Though the Pharaoh who gave the light of their soul to this bow has disappeared into history, their desire to protect their people lives on. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Lycan Compound Bow
description: Developed and designed by Lycan Alphas, this sure-shot compound bow aids in the victory of its wielder, even against their greatest rivals.

name: Magistral's Longbow
description: These Aeromancers gain power from the very air around them. Wind power!

name: Magma Bow
description: This lava bow blasts flaming arrows at foes.

name: Magus' Sun Hunter Bow
description: Legends tell of a Hero that shot down ten suns that drifted too close together, preventing that end of the universe from being engulfed in flames. These arrows are the closest replication of that hunter's weapons.

name: Master Phoenix Bow
description: Strong and sturdy, able to fend off Trolls.

name: Masterful Bow of the Truth
description: For a hunter seeking veracity, fire an arrow at the liars and they will sing the truth.

name: Mindflayer's Infested Bow
description: The ocean is teeming with life, and it takes as much as it gives. You tore this bow out of a mighty sea beast to live, just as it did to another when it was a calf. The dark cycle continues, but that is a mere fact of nature.

name: MockingSlayer Bow (AC)
description: Your enemies will Rue the day they face this bow in battle.

name: MockingSlayer Bow (Non-AC)
description: Your enemies will Rue the day they face this bow in battle.

name: Monster Bone Bow
description: Bones do make excellent bows.

name: Mortis Chrono Bow
description: When the target's time of death is decided, the Phantom Chronomancer nocks an arrow and shoots. It carries the power of inevitability, and never misses its mark.

name: Necrotfinger's Bow
description: How many parts of Rotfinger ARE there in the Underworld? Now the Necromancers are using bits of them to make weapons.

name: Necrotic Bow of the Shadow
description: Honor, you gain honor by killing those who already have earned it. Respect, you earn respect by killing all of those who have gained honor and only then you will become the most feared in the land!

name: Nemoralia
description: Victoria's personal bow possessed by The Unsung's influence. Each arrow nocked and shot is a command. Everyone they strike down will rise again as loyal knights.

name: New Year Dawning
description: May you shoot straight and true all through the new year and beyond!

name: NightFrost Elf Bow
description: Elves are some of the most resourceful beings in Lore. Even the colds of the Northlands cannot keep these skilled warriors away.

name: Nightmare Bow
description: As you wander through terrifying dream-realms, make sure you have this bow at your side to increase the range of your inevitable attacks on Night Mares and Shadow Stalkers.

name: One Eyed Bow
description: Dolls wear bows in their hair. One-Eyed Dolls wield wickedly awesome punk rock bows in battle! This rare weapon was discovered during the live One-Eyes Doll event.

name: Ornate Leonine Bow
description: Unleash the power of the lion.

name: Phantom Chrono Bow
description: When the target's time of death is decided, the Phantom Chronomancer nocks an arrow, and shoots. It carries the power of inevitability and never misses its mark.

name: Phoenix Bow
description: Might not be the fanciest bow but it'll take down Imps in one shot.

name: Plasmic Energy Bow 3000
description: The silver light on this arrow can fly long distances if launched and implodes on impact. Utilizing this bow in an archery match is not recommended under any circumstances.

name: Plasmid Bow
description: Toxic sludge slurps through the coils running up and down this bow. It cools the weapon which heightens the efficiency of the transcapacitator.

name: Platinum Technocaster Bow
description: Technocasters are a group of elite Seraphic warriors from the future. Platinum Technocaster's are the highest class of these

name: Pure Octantis Bow (0 AC)
description: During the darkest of nights, the Light bestowed a star upon a worthy bowman. It was shot into the heavens, summoning the morning sun. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Pure Octantis Bow (AC)
description: During the darkest of nights, the Light bestowed a star upon a worthy bowman. It was shot into the heavens, summoning the morning sun. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: RavenLord Commander's Bow (0 AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: RavenLord Commander's Bow (AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: Regal Dragon Hunter Yumi
description: A man became a Prince when he helped his brother slay an evil Dragon, bringing the Yokai Isles into an age of prosperity. These bows are regal copies of his original wooden weapon.

name: Rogue of Time's Bow
description: The light of these enchanted arrows is often mistaken for the power of Light. Care should be taken to shoot them correctly, should the arrow rip through the fabric of time and prevent a bystander's birth.

name: Rotfinger's Bow
description: I'm not sure if this is Rotfinger's weapon… or a weapon made out of bits of Rotfinger. Ew.

name: Rotfinger's Hollowborn Bow
description: Pieces of Rotfinger made their way to the Underworld, so the Hollowborn incorporated them into a set of weapons.

name: Royal Swordhaven Bow
description: This elegant, golden bow is used by King Alteon's royal archers.

name: Sakura Bough Bow
description: The sweet petals fall gently to the ground. A whisper-soft blush upon the still, silent snow.

name: Sandrunner Longbow
description: The type of longbow used by the Sandrunners of the Sandsea for their daily hunting.

name: Scythian Bow
description: THe Legion Arena's archers shoot anyone who's caught breaking rules. In a war, they can strike enemies from miles away. Dage forges glass eyes for them to be able to see such distances. The one caveat is that they're very fragile.

name: Seraphic Dragoon Bow
description: Capable of firing sunlike arrows that can fly within several yards high off the ground before making an explosive impact.

name: Serene Moon Bow (0 AC)
description: The night belongs to darkness, but so does the moon. We yearn for what we can not have and what we can not be. The bow and its arrows take aim at dreams. Ones that could become true and yours. (Changes in combat)

name: Serene Moon Bow (AC)
description: The night belongs to darkness, but so does the moon. We yearn for what we can not have and what we can not be. The bow and its arrows take aim at dreams. Ones that could become true and yours. (Changes in combat)

name: Serene Sharpshooter Bow
description: The bright power emanating from this bow soothes your spirit and renews your flagging energy. It is a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Shadow Beastmaster Bow
description: Using the powers of Shadow and Chaos, these BeastMasters use all their skills in support of Malgor.

name: Shadow Phoenix Bow
description: Can a shadow rise from the ashes of the great phoenix instead of a flame?

name: ShadowBow of the Shadows
description: How you came in possession of this bow is a mystery but it sure wasn't an honorable way.

name: ShadowSlayer's Heirloom Bow
description: Most ShadowSlayers are too restless to settle down. Their implements and skills are passed to students. This heirloom has seen several generations of people from all walks of life, joined by their duty to hunt.

name: Shadowstalker's Bow
description: The elemental-affected snow has caused this bow to be as strong as ice, enhancing its sharp durability.

name: Shockwave Paralyzer Bow
description: The Shockwave Scholar's arrows aren't meant to be fatal. They paralyze potential test subjects so the scholars can safely bring them back to their labs.

name: Silver Vindicator Bow
description: As a conscript, you are eligible to wield the Silver Vindicator weapons.

name: SilverStag Longbow
description: A mystical weapon discovered in Lore, the SilverStag Longbow is the perfect weapon for eliminating enemies from a far distance.

name: Silverwind Bow
description: A bow of Dwarven make, given to the Elaphinos when they needed a way to protect themselves from hunters. In return, the Druids healed the burns that scarred Dwarfhold's mountains.

name: Sir Valence's Longshot
description: Sir Valence's trusty bow with a string of dreadspider silk for enhanced distance.

name: SkyDancer's Ritual Bow
description: During the Cerulean Moon ceremony, dancers praying to the Sky Gods shoot flaming arrows towards the stars.

name: Snowstalker's Bow
description: The elemental-affected snow has caused this bow to be as strong as ice, enhancing its sharp durability.

name: Sorcerer Sun Hunter Bow
description: Legends tell of a Hero that shot down ten suns that drifted too close together, preventing that end of the universe from being engulfed in flames. These arrows are the closest replication of that hunter's weapons.

name: Soulforged Eviscerator Bow (0 AC)
description: A bow that crackles with energy from haunted steel. The bowstring will burn away the flesh of a mortal. Only a loyal member of the Legion can harness its power.

name: Soulforged Eviscerator Bow (AC)
description: A bow that crackles with energy from haunted steel. The bowstring will burn away the flesh of a mortal. Only a loyal member of the Legion can harness its power.

name: SpiritHunter's Bow
description: That bitter chill you feel is NOT coming from the frigid Northlands wind… it's the icy aura of the invisible spirits surrounding you. Watching… waiting… Will they strike first? Or will you?

name: Spring Woodlands Bow
description: The forest reawakens, and blossoms spring open to grace the day. Take this branch of new life, and set forth on your journey. You both have a long road ahead, blessed and cursed by the changing seasons.

name: Stealth Crossbow
description: Nulgath's crossbow packs a punch no matter if you have arrows or not!

name: SteamGear Bow
description: As the SteamGear travels from town to town selling their steampunk inventions and repairing anything that needs it, they will encounter some unsavory elements. Get the drop of the bag guys with this ornate bow.

name: Steampunk Geobow
description: When you tug on the bowstring, the contraption pulls in air, superheats it, and condenses it into steam arrows. It's recommended that you handle this weapon with gloves.

name: Steampunk Lovebow (Bow)
description: Comes with auto-targeting so you'll never miss your mark! No warranty. Beware of malfunctions.

name: Sterling Silver Crossbow
description: The hybrid combination of a gun and a bow--a crossbow! It's like the big boys' slingshot… only a lot more deadly and accurate. And expensive.

name: Sterling Silver Longbow
description: Lightweight yet powerful, this sterling silver longbow proves super effective against rabid wolves and troublesome rust.

name: Strong Bow of Zelkur
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Sunblaze Bow
description: An artifact that has never stopped burning. Some believe it was meant to shoot the Sun out of the sky. Others whisper that it was created on the Sun, meant to shoot down Lore.

name: Swordhaven Bow
description: Defend Swordhaven with this mighty bow!

name: Swordhaven Emissary Bow
description: It’s preferred that the Swordhaven Emissary not appear armed. Bow and arrows, however, are a necessity. Bandits are a universal problem, as are assassins tasked with ruining diplomatic efforts.

name: Swordhaven Guard's Bow
description: Shoot straight, let your arrows fly true, and long live King Alteon!

name: Taranis Salvation Bow
description: Bowmen that tap into the power of the storm can direct lightning to strike their targets, at the cost of being electrified themselves. On the Hill of Lia Tara, the last bow was claimed by invaders.

name: Tech Archer Bow
description: With a targeting scope and unlimited supply of energy projectiles, this bow a perfect killing weapon!

name: The Crescent of Inferno Bow
description: This bow doesn't require arrows but only the will of its master to forge magical projectiles.

name: Timeseeker's Bow
description: Only the most skilled Treasurehunters become Timeseekers, questing across the timestreams that make up the fabric of our universe.

name: Tora Daimyo's Bow
description: Elaborate armor worn by only the highest level of Akiban defenders. Rank is denoted by the symbols on your chest.

name: Twisted Eldritch Bow
description: The deepest depths hide some of the strangest and most dangerous beasts.

name: Twisted Gift Bow
description: Made of frozen meat and sharpened bones, this blade is only a gift if you're not the one its being used on.

name: Tyre Akh Bow
description: Death is but another part of life. Only the soul should be immortal. The Emissaries of Melqart ensure that it is so by guiding and guarding the dead seeking the next world. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Umbral Bow of Aaru
description: The preferred weapon of Apophis' elite Medjai. Their umbral arrows cut through the clouds, turning the sun's rays violet. They rained upon the forces of Light, turning hapless warriors into patches of wet sand.

name: Unending Light Bow
description: A great bow of Light found deep within the tomb of a Sandsea Pharaoh. It was left behind, its purpose forgotten. It may never call on the Titan of Light again.

name: Unrequited Love's Bow
description: The anti-cupid. Shot with this bow will cause a person to not return any feelings of love.

name: Vampiric Longbow
description: Best suited for Vampiric archers, this longbow features the traditional craftsmanship of Darkovian architecture.

name: Ventus Core Stinger Bow
description: In obscure legends, the winds that blow across Lore are from the beating of a divine beast's feathery wings. Others argue that it's a dragonfly's. What if it was both?

name: Vibrant Bow of Zelkur
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Vindicator Scout's Bow
description: A lightweight silver bow embellished by a golden V to help Vindicators identify each other. It's a subtle bow fit for recruits considering joining the scouting force.

name: White Stalker's Bow
description: White Stalkers need a bow that won't shatter in the cold… and here it is!

name: Winter's Beauty Bow
description: The snow gently drifts down off your blade, floating into the still calm of a quiet winter's night.

name: Woodlands Winter Bow
description: As snow falls silently over the lake a lone wolf's howl can be heard. Soon, an eternal darkness will fall… unless you keep your wits sharp and your shooting sharper.

name: WraithTaker Bow
description: Those who hunt the elusive dullahan must be cunning, quick, and brave. And a good shot.

name: Wretched Scolex of the Void
description: Nation Contractors were dipped into the Void to become Fiends, but emerged dead. Inside them wriggled wretched parasites. Amused, Nulgath forged them into a bow that creates arrows from the wielder's blood.

name: Yokai Saggitarian Bow
description: "I ask the flames - do not belittle my commitment to start a new life… I want to forget the things I've done in the past, and how I spread ashes, not knowing it as a sin."

name: Zhoom's 16-bit Shortbow
description: 16-bit arrows not included.

name: Zhoom's Dragonbow
description: A ranger's aim is steady and true. This bow will enhance the strength of your arm and the surety of your sight. Zhoom will be envious of the accuracy of your shots.

name: Zombie Slayer Bow
description: Looks like you've been shopping at S-Mart.
